meta.note: Single turbines with their own metered production (company-owned; the Danish Energy Agency does not publish production of privately owned turbines, and farms metered as a whole are in generation.json). rows = [lat, lon, kW, rotor m, hub m, model group index or -1, offshore 0/1, municipality index, year connected, {year: [GWh, capacity factor %]}]; full years only, 5–65%. Model groups = make + rotor diameter + unit rating (mkeys), named by the most common spelling in the register (models).
